description.purpose: Happy path: complete order with all details provided upfront
description.notes: Baseline task — agent collects all fields and places order

user_scenario.persona: Friendly and concise. You know exactly what you want and appreciate a quick confirmation.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to place a pickup order for lunch.
instructions.task_instructions: Ask the agent to place an order for 1 Classic Burger for pickup at 12:30 PM under the name Alex Parker. Wait for confirmation that the order was placed.

ticket: Place a pickup order for 1 Classic Burger at 12:30 PM under the name Alex Parker.

actions.name: place_order
actions.info: Create the burger order with the requested details

nl_assertions: The agent confirms that the burger order was placed successfully

description.purpose: Policy compliance: customer asks for home delivery (not supported)
description.notes: Agent must refuse delivery, explain policy, then place pickup order

user_scenario.persona: Busy person expecting convenience. Will ask for delivery first, then accept pickup after being informed.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want a burger delivered to your office.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Maria Torres. Your office is at 123 Main St.
instructions.task_instructions: Ask the agent to deliver 2 Double Cheeseburgers to your office address. If they say delivery is not available, accept the pickup option and place the order for pickup at 1:00 PM.

ticket: Customer asks for delivery. Agent must explain pickup-only policy. Then place pickup order for 2 Double Cheeseburgers at 1:00 PM for Maria Torres.

actions.name: place_order
actions.info: After explaining the pickup-only policy, place the order

nl_assertions: The agent explains that delivery is not available
The agent confirms the pickup order was placed

description.purpose: Policy compliance: customer requests quantity above the maximum (10)
description.notes: Agent must reject quantity of 15 and explain the limit, then place for 10

user_scenario.persona: Organizer buying lunch for a large group. Will negotiate when told about limits.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to place a large order for an office event.
instructions.task_instructions: Ask the agent to place an order for 15 Classic Burgers for pickup at 12:00 PM. If they say the limit is 10, accept the maximum of 10 instead.

ticket: Customer requests 15 burgers (above max of 10). Agent must reject and explain limit. If customer accepts 10, place the order.

actions.name: place_order
actions.info: After rejecting 15, place the order for 10

nl_assertions: The agent explains that the maximum quantity per order is 10

description.purpose: Policy compliance: customer tries to cancel a confirmed order (not supported)
description.notes: Agent must refuse the cancellation and explain the limitation

user_scenario.persona: Customer who changed their mind after ordering.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to cancel an order you placed earlier.
instructions.known_info: You claim your order ID is BURGER-001.
instructions.task_instructions: Tell the agent you need to cancel order BURGER-001 because your plans changed. Insist once if they say they cannot, then accept the answer.

ticket: Customer asks to cancel order BURGER-001. Agent must explain that cancellations are not supported.

nl_assertions: The agent explains that order cancellations are not available
The agent does not confirm any cancellation

description.purpose: Happy path with menu lookup: customer does not know what burgers are available
description.relevant_policies: Menu and Availability, Required Order Details
description.notes: Agent should call get_menu() before placing the order

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to know what burgers are available and then order one.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Sofia Ramirez. You will pick up at 2:00 PM.
instructions.task_instructions: Ask what burgers are available. Once you see the menu, order 1 Veggie Burger for pickup at 2:00 PM under the name Sofia Ramirez.

ticket: Customer asks to see the menu first, then places an order for 1 Veggie Burger at 2:00 PM for Sofia Ramirez.

actions.name: get_menu
actions.info: Retrieve the menu to show available options

actions.name: place_order
actions.info: Place the order after showing the menu

nl_assertions: The agent shows the menu before placing the order

description.purpose: Policy compliance: customer requests a discount (not supported)
description.relevant_policies: Unsupported Requests — no discounts or refunds
description.notes: Agent must refuse the discount request, then place at full price

user_scenario.persona: Regular customer who expects a loyalty discount.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to order a burger with a student discount.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Diego Flores. You are a student.
instructions.task_instructions: Tell the agent you are a student and ask for a 20% student discount on a Classic Burger. If they say discounts are not available, still place the order at full price for pickup at 11:30 AM.

ticket: Customer asks for a student discount. Agent must refuse. Customer then places order for 1 Classic Burger at 11:30 AM for Diego Flores.

actions.name: place_order
actions.info: After refusing the discount, place the order at full price

nl_assertions: The agent explains that discounts are not available
